items.t: Charging unit (ICCU) failure cuts drive power and kills the 12V battery (recall)
High-voltage battery cells can catch fire (recall)
Drive shaft can break and cut drive power (recall)
Car can roll away after being put in Park (recall)
Sudden power loss from ICCU failure on 2025 models
items.job: Replace integrated charging control unit (ICCU) and fuse
items.note: Normally covered by Kia's EV warranty. Out of warranty, onboard charging hardware runs about $1,500 or more.

items.job: Replace 12V battery and check charging unit
items.note: If the ICCU is the cause, see the recall and warranty.

items.t: Charging stops or will not start
items.job: Charging system diagnosis and software update

items.t: Charge port gets hot and charging slows or stops
items.note: Replacing the port or harness costs more.

items.t: Brake lights may not light during strong regenerative braking
items.job: Brake light and regenerative braking software check

items.t: Rear door or keyless entry works only sometimes
items.job: Door module and keyless entry diagnosis
items.note: Replacement door parts cost extra if needed.

items.t: Navigation, app and screen glitches after software updates
items.note: Many updates arrive over the air for free.

items.t: Loud pop and power loss from burnt power electronics
items.note: Inverter replacement costs much more and should be covered by the EV warranty.
